scope: Independent review of phase4 plan-core.json, portfolio.json and reconstruction.json against existing phase2/phase3 evidence.
status: Pass for proposed product roadmap; no unresolved findings
deployment_status: No implementation, connector, vendor access, procurement or live-operation validation was performed by this review.

checks.check: Single authoritative system per record class
checks.detail: ATS or minimal owned core is an explicit alternative; owned workflow/audit stores reference records and evidence. Contract-designated time and provider financial records retain authority.

Twelve capability areas form three shared-platform experiences; specialist services are established, while workflow/policy, controlled actions and evidence are owned. ATS vendor selection remains conditional.
Public observations, vendor documentation, proposed behavior and private unknowns are separated. No production schema, hidden data, working tenant connector or complete internal-clone claim.
Competitor jobs are market observations rather than own orders or candidate supply; public contracts and rates are examples rather than the new operator's binding terms.
Clinical services and attestations retain qualified ownership; consequential employment and finance actions have named owners. Proposed human gates are not presented as universal law.
Release slices, tests, pilots and live delegation are explicitly future criteria. No observed automation ROI, headcount replacement or 100% autonomy conclusion.
All portfolio and reconstruction source IDs resolve to phase3 sources. All portfolio/state-machine workflow IDs resolve to phase2 workflow stages.

findings.detail: Transition arrays are illustrative subsets, with some connecting and terminal transitions omitted. Label them as illustrative excerpts, not exhaustive or executable specifications, to match future specification work.
findings.resolution: Root added an explicit global state_machine_scope and a scope note on all four examples stating that transitions are illustrative, non-exhaustive and not executable specifications. Verified after edit.
